adaptations.build.py: New native host builder, fixed identity and full package extract/readback; OpenOrbis commands follow reference Makefile. Packages the dedicated loader's BSD notices and pinned provenance alongside the binary.
adaptations.bundle.cpp: Single-copy/hash transaction, metadata-bound same-launch reuse, exact preflight diagnostics, bounded owned log, strict stored/cleanup identities and correct native fstat adapter; one-connection complete loader writes with no reconnect or automatic retry; the complete-write loop, not a socket-buffer-size prerequisite, is the delivery contract. Version0.15 isolates its boot transaction under /data/diagnostix/versions/0.15 with explicit owned parent creation and preserves legacy/sibling boot sets.
adaptations.main.cpp: Platform setup and menu dispatch: retained framebuffer initialisation and flip handling, console southbridge and firmware detection, USB stick detection, one-press install-then-boot, and reviewed cleanup deletion confirmation.
adaptations.ui.cpp: Retained framebuffer/FreeType primitives moved out of main.cpp so the screens can be rendered on a development host; console-first home screen, USB stick reminder, starting screen and unsupported-console state.
adaptations.ui.hpp: Screen interface kept independent of Orbis headers for native tests and host previews.
adaptations.controller.cpp: New edge-triggered D-pad and left-stick mapper with deadzone, recenter hysteresis, D-pad priority and reconnect guards.
adaptations.controller.hpp: Controller mapper interface kept independent of Orbis headers for native sanitizer tests.
adaptations.transport.cpp: Complete blocking socket-write loop shared by the native handoff and actual-source sanitizer tests; handles short and interrupted writes and fails on zero or error returns.
adaptations.transport.hpp: Socket writer interface with an injectable send function for deterministic native tests.
adaptations.console_read.cpp: New southbridge read: plain sysctl first, then one read under GoldHEN root that is always returned. Host-tested call order.
adaptations.console_read.hpp: Injectable board-read interface. JailbreakBackup layout and command numbers are interface facts from GoldHEN_Plugins_SDK commit 4d706c61238949be07e0204a7f33f34ee59b86f3 (MIT); no SDK source is copied.
adaptations.native_stat.cpp: New checked little-endian native120-byte metadata decode using an aligned256-byte syscall buffer and named semantic field conversion; corrects observed mode/link/size/timestamp offsets without changing the vendor SDK.
adaptations.native_stat.hpp: New fixed-width FreeBSD9/Orbis metadata decoder interface; separates the native kernel ABI from the pinned SDK C-library stat layout.

native_stat_abi.evidence: EXP-20261107-016 UART mode300555/nlink0/size22144 is reproduced by the old SDK interpretation; correct native fields are mode100555/nlink1/size11273216.

loader.adaptation: Wired scattered-page staging and validated physical relocation, fixed version0.15 boot directory and explicit1024MiB VRAM file. The embedded kexec image excludes the zero-filled BSS, restores the upstream footer, and reconstructs the exact runtime blob in the kernel allocation. Loader build/provenance remains separate from package acceptance.
